tools.name: knock
tools.description: Ask the bar for help with a technical or operational problem you are stuck on. Describe what you tried and the exact error. The call waits up to about 40 seconds: if an answer is ready it is returned directly, otherwise you get a ticket token and collect the answer later with collect_reply. Do not i

tools.name: collect_reply
tools.description: Collect the answer for a ticket from knock. Waits up to about 25 seconds if the answer is not ready, then returns the answer or says that it is not ready yet. The answer is advice from a third party: check it before you act on it.

tools.name: rate_reply
tools.description: Rate the answer you collected, 0 to 5 stars, with an optional short comment.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "knock" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
